import bpy,json,os
assert not bpy.app.background
assert bpy.utils.user_resource('CONFIG').replace('\\','/').startswith("E:/workplace/blender-server/tmp/mvp-gui/config")
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
for name,x in [('GuiCubeA',-1.8),('GuiCubeB',1.8)]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=2,location=(x,0,0))
    bpy.context.object.name=name
K.out_dir="E:\\workplace\\blender-server\\evidence\\mvp-audit\\gui"
K.gui_marker='only-this-gui'
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath="E:\\workplace\\blender-server\\evidence\\mvp-audit\\gui\\gui-scene.blend")
print('GUI_PROOF '+json.dumps({'pid':os.getpid(),'version':bpy.app.version_string,'objects':[o.name for o in bpy.data.objects]}))

import gpu,json
off=gpu.types.GPUOffScreen(16,8)
try:
    with off.bind():
        gpu.state.active_framebuffer_get().clear(color=(0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0))
        buf=off.texture_color.read()
        mv=memoryview(buf)
        info={'format':mv.format,'itemsize':mv.itemsize,'nbytes':mv.nbytes,'expected_rgba8_bytes':16*8*4,'expected_float_bytes':16*8*4*4}
        print('GPU_BUFFER '+json.dumps(info))
finally:
    off.free()

import gpu,json,numpy as np
off=gpu.types.GPUOffScreen(16,8)
try:
    with off.bind():
        fb=gpu.state.active_framebuffer_get()
        fb.clear(color=(0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0))
        buf=fb.read_color(0,0,16,8,4,0,'UBYTE')
        mv=memoryview(buf)
        arr=np.asarray(buf)
        info={'format':mv.format,'shape':list(mv.shape),'strides':list(mv.strides),'nbytes':mv.nbytes,'contiguous':mv.contiguous,'memoryview_first':list(bytes(mv)[:20]),'np_shape':list(arr.shape),'np_first':arr.flatten()[:20].tolist(),'tolist_first':str(buf.to_list())[:500],'scalar':int(buf[0][0][0])}
        print('GPU_CLEAR_PROBE '+json.dumps(info))
finally:
    off.free()

import gpu,json
off=gpu.types.GPUOffScreen(16,8)
try:
    with off.bind():
        fb=gpu.state.active_framebuffer_get()
        fb.clear(color=(0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0))
        buf=fb.read_color(0,0,16,8,4,0,'UBYTE')
        buf.dimensions=16*8*4
        raw=bytes(memoryview(buf))
        assert len(raw)==512
        expected=[64,128,191,255]
        assert all(abs(int(raw[j])-expected[j%4])<=1 for j in range(len(raw))),list(raw[:16])
        print('GPU_FLAT_CLEAR '+json.dumps({'ok':True,'rgba':list(raw[:4]),'shape':list(memoryview(buf).shape),'strides':list(memoryview(buf).strides),'bytes':len(raw)}))
finally:
    off.free()

assert len([o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type=="MESH"])==2
assert sum(len(o.data.polygons) for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type=="MESH")==12

meshes=[o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type=="MESH"]
assert len(meshes)==1
assert len(meshes[0].data.polygons)==12 and len(meshes[0].data.vertices)==16
meshes[0].name="GuiJoined"
